{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}...Should I not have come?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Do as you like. But I can't give you much attention.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you confident with the sword?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:018000800180}{n}I have a fair amount of confidence in myself as I am... But there is always someone better.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you usually enjoy doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...I suppose. When I cross swords with the squires.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Anything you're careful about?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}... Matters concerning the kingdom weigh on me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem used to walking.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes. It's fundamental.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you want to get stronger?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like taking walks?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...I don't dislike it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're in quite a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I can't waste time.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...I've never thought about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you worried about your country?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...I'm not worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Even away from the order, I am still working for everyone's sake.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...There's more?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I just wondered what you were up to.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you for your hard work today.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I... intruding?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}You came all this way to say that?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}... That is what I intend to do.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought we might talk a little...{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}... Not now.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you guard the castle at night too?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}... Of course. Guarding the castle knows no day or night.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like the town at night?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes... I do.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}The town lights seen from the castle are beautiful. They reflect the warmth of people's lives.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...Same as always.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Must a hero be watched that closely?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Didn't you just eat a while ago?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...That's none of your concern.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Something smells good.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I suppose so.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}... You followed me just to say that?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you careful about what you eat?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I am. An unbalanced diet won't keep the body healthy.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you always eat alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}At the castle, I usually eat with my comrades in the order.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...I don't mind that, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes. If I don't rest up, I'll be in trouble when it counts.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...Not bad.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem to be in a good mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Let me see...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}... Don't fuss over me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do the order's soldiers get days off?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes, of course. Knights are only human. Without rest, they'd be in trouble.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, as always.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...It's too early for thanks. Wait until everyone can live in peace.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please don't push yourself too hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...Was that all you came for?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That looks hard. Why not rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}No need to worry.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...Of course. If you have no other business... go.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Daily learning is important, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}That's right. Steady effort is needed in all things. Neglect it and you won't grow.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}...Should I not have come?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...No need for concern. You must have come for a reason.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you used a sword since childhood?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yes... Ever since I was a child.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What's a knight's most vital training?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}... Effort, and building up real experience. Though of course, that isn't all.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}The breeze feels nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Honestly... you're a carefree one.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's nothing you need to worry about.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm not hungry. What about you? Getting hungry yourself?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If you want to rest, that's fine by me. Suit yourself.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does being with me tire you out?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's tiring, like being watched. Well, maybe you've got it rough too.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we hurry a little more?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}No way. I've got my own pace, and I don't want it thrown off.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Anything you'd like to do right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'd like to have a drink with my thief buddies. Things have been way too refined lately. It's stifling.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}When it comes to letting loose and raising hell, those guys are the best.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you usually enjoy doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}When I'm out having a blast, obviously. That's the most fun there is.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Anything you're careful about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Let's see... I try to stay away from knights and guards when I run into them.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But I worry more about the guys I left behind than about myself. Lots of them were dimwits...{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem used to walking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}That's some kind of flattery, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you want to get stronger?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I hate losing too. Being strong never hurts.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Not that I'd lose to any of the usual riffraff even now.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you thirsty?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Quit whining! You're the one who tagged along.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like taking walks?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I kinda like just wandering around, easygoing.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're in quite a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Dawdle and I'll leave you behind.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Obviously. If I could fly, I wouldn't be slogging like this.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You just don't get it 'cause you can fly.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Traveling is fun, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Never thought I'd hear that from you... You looked like you couldn't handle getting tired, but you're fine, huh.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What were you thinking about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I was wondering if stealing's really that bad... and I still can't see that it is.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I just wondered what you were up to.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm not doing anything. ...You weren't suspecting I'd gone off stealing or something, were you?{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you for your hard work today.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You came at this hour just to say that? Real dedicated of you.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I... intruding?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You come in the middle of the night and say that? If you think so, then don't come.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm not tired. Quit worrying about me.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought we might talk a little...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I don't have anything to talk long about. I'm no good at serious talk anyway.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
